notes: `οὐ` (s003) is `unrepresented` under rule 41, `οὐδενί` carrying the whole English negation as *none*.
`κενώσῃ` heads on *void* under rule 17's support/resultative clause, not on the finite *make*.
`καλόν` carries the supplied *it were* under rule 68, the clause expressing no subject of its own.
